item.title: Grandma Gatewood hiked 2,190-mile Appalachian Trail alone at 67
item.summary: Emma Gatewood etched her name in history in 1955 as the first woman to conquer the Appalachian Trail solo at the remarkable age of 67. With minimal equipment, she bravely journeyed over 2,190 miles, transforming the narrative around long-distance hiking for women. Her perseverance and spirit culminated in two additional hikes, serving as an inspiration for countless adventurers seeking freedom and adventure.
